title: Rejecting a Reading: No es que… sino que…
goal: Reject a misreading of your position with no es que + subjunctive and sino que + indicative, and put your own reading in its place.
grammar: rejecting a reading with no es que… sino que…

items: I can reject a reading of my position with *No es que…, sino que…*.
I can use the subjunctive in the rejected part and the indicative in the true part, in the present and the past.
I can describe a disagreement with *cuestionar*, *malinterpretar* and *restringir*.
